postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is required and cannot be substituted by unit tests for four properties that only exist at the database boundary: (1) append-only enforcement on legal_instrument_versions and account_legal_acceptances (I-T2-2, I-T3-2) is a property of RLS/omitted policies, and a mocked client would happily accept an UPDATE the database refuses; (2) the I-T3-1 uniqueness invariant is the concurrency control for simultaneous acceptance; (3) the RLS postures R-CL1-1, R-CL1-3, R-CL1-4 are policy behaviour, never probed before this unit (U-AO-1 was open); (4) the org-less audit INSERT admission (R-CL1-6) is policy behaviour and is the specific gap F-AO-15 records. Run exclusively via the canonical disposable harness (scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts) — never staging, never production, never the canonical local stack.

positive_controls.description: Any authenticated subject reads T1 (legal_instruments) and T2 (legal_instrument_versions) in full.
A subject may INSERT their own account-class acceptance row (T3).
T3 SELECT is scoped to the subject themselves; another subject's acceptance never leaks into a scoped read.
A subject current on the latest EFFECTIVE marked version passes the currency predicate even though a later version exists that is not yet effective (pre-effective versions never refuse).
The org-less account-class acceptance audit INSERT (organization_id NULL, action legal.account_instrument_accepted, actor = auth.uid()) is admitted.
0042 and 0067's audit_logs INSERT policies remain byte-unchanged and functioning: exactly three INSERT policies exist on audit_logs after this unit (0042, 0067, CL-1).
requireAuth: a verified, accepted subject passes through with no redirect.
requireOrganizationAccess: an accepted member with a selected organization reaches the ordinary Packet A destination unchanged.
requireOrganizationAccess: an ACCEPTED super-admin with no membership still reaches /admin — L0 does not disturb R1 once satisfied.
getCurrentOrganizationContext returns the context for an accepted subject.
withAuthenticatedDatabaseContext succeeds for a verified, accepted subject.

Both of requirePrincipal's return sites (memo-hit and fresh) route through the SAME assertPrincipalGates helper, which asserts B0 (assertEmailVerifiedPrincipal) before L0 (assertAccountAcceptanceCurrentPrincipal).

negative_controls.description: T2 INSERT is denied for any tenant role — no publisher write path exists (PLATFORM_PUBLISHER_DEPENDENCY).
T2 UPDATE is denied — append-only.
T2 DELETE is denied — append-only.
T3 INSERT for another subject is denied — no delegation of account-class acceptance.
T3 UPDATE is denied — append-only.
T3 DELETE is denied — append-only.
A duplicate acceptance of the same (user, version) pair is refused by the unique constraint (23505), not silently accepted as a second row.
An acceptance whose snapshotted content_digest does not equal the referenced version's digest is refused by the BEFORE INSERT trigger.
An ORGANIZATION-class instrument version cannot be accepted through the account-acceptance (T3) path — refused by the trigger.
A subject with ZERO acceptances never passes the currency predicate vacuously.
A subject current only on a superseded version (a later version is marked reaccept_required and already effective) is refused, identically to never having accepted.

Adding a required key with ZERO published versions to the conjunction refuses the WHOLE gate, even for a subject otherwise current on every other required key — empty/partial registry fail closed, no vacuous truth.
The org-less audit policy refuses a different action string even with organization_id NULL — the verb set is closed, not a generic anonymous write.
The org-less audit policy refuses an actor_user_id that does not match auth.uid() — an acceptance cannot be attributed to someone else.
requireAuth redirects a verified, unaccepted subject to ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH.
requireAuth redirects an UNVERIFIED, unaccepted subject to /verify-email, never to ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH — B0 precedes L0.
requireOrganizationAccess redirects an unaccepted member to ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH, never reaching R1 through R4.
PACKET_A_PRESERVATION P-AO-13 analogue: an UNACCEPTED super-admin is ALSO redirected to ACCEPT_LEGAL_PATH, never auto-routed to /admin — L0 applies uniformly, no principal-class bypass.
getCurrentOrganizationContext returns null for an unaccepted subject even with a full membership and organization.
withAuthenticatedDatabaseContext throws AUTH_LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED for a verified, unaccepted subject, mapped to HTTP 403 (never 401).
N-AO-1 analogue: an UNVERIFIED, unaccepted subject is refused with AUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, not AUTH_LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED.

mutation_controls.description: The currency-predicate function (lib/auth/legal-acceptance.ts deriveAccountAcceptanceCurrent) is deliberately never wrapped in a try/catch that could convert a query failure into a permissive `true` (FAIL_CLOSED.FC_6) — removing that discipline (e.g. wrapping the db.execute call and returning true on error) would defeat the entire model and is guarded by the function's own contract; the real-PostgreSQL suite exercises the function against a live connection so any accidental catch-and-pass would need to be introduced and reviewed as a visible code change, not a config flag.

Structural control proving requirePrincipal's memo-hit and fresh-resolution return sites are bound to the SAME assertPrincipalGates helper — moving the L0 check to only the fresh branch (the memo-trap regression class) would be caught by this control failing.

sentinels.purpose: The org-less acceptance audit row (R-CL1-6) carries only instrumentKey, version and contentDigest in afterJson — never instrument text. Verified by inspection of the exact payload shape the server action (app/(public)/accept-legal/actions.ts) constructs; no raw instrument content field exists anywhere on the write path.

None of the five policies this unit adds (legal_instruments_select, legal_instrument_versions_select, account_legal_acceptances_select, account_legal_acceptances_insert, audit_logs_insert_legal_acceptance) contains current_user_is_super_admin() or any hasRole comparison — verified by direct reading of db/migrations/0070_customer_lifecycle_cl1_legal_acceptance.sql and by the db/hosted/baseline-scanner.ts securitySurfaceDigest pinned in db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts, which changes if any predicate's TEXT changes.
